hypothesis: Within a regular-season week, closing favorites in repeat opponent pairings have lower win-minus-closing-probability residuals than favorites in first meetings; familiarity may reduce the advantage priced for the stronger team.

source.license: Publisher CC BY4.0; attribution retained; upstream rights not certified; CSV private
source.method: Publisher median of proportionally de-vigged probabilities; same compiler as prior NBA/NHL, not independent validation

prior_exposure.metadata: README season-wide aggregate rates/schema inspected. Search snippets exposed two full game rows before registration.
prior_exposure.rule: These rows supply schedule identity only; exclude their outcomes from every evaluated group. No bulk CSV/rematch subgroup results inspected. Not an untouched holdout.

population: 2025 regular season only; postseason excluded before features; no2026 data.
feature: For each unordered pair of stable team IDs, treated iff a regular-season meeting has a strictly earlier start in the same season. Schedule only; previous winner/margin/odds/injuries never define treatment. Other eligible games are controls.
selection: One closing favorite per game: home if close_home_win_prob>0.5,away if<0.5; exactly0.5 excluded. Tied finals excluded because offered tie settlement/conditional probability is uncertified. Report exclusions. No executable decision-time or book-price claim.
primary: Within each week with both groups,D_week=mean(favorite_win-favorite_close_probability)_treated minus control mean. Primary=sum(n_treated_week*D_week)/sum(n_treated_week). Weeks lacking either group have zero primary weight and remain reported.

uncertainty.method: Circular blocks of3 consecutive NFL week labels over full1..18 grid,including zero-weight weeks; sample6blocks=18weeks/draw; recompute weighted contrast
uncertainty.interval: 95% percentile,linear interpolation at(n-1)*q; report skipped zero-treated draws

support_rule: Descriptive lead only if contrast<=-0.03 and upper95<0;otherwise not_supported. Sample/gate failure insufficient_data/aborted. No fitted coefficients,subgroups,alternate lines or threshold sweeps.
limits: Closing consensus is a benchmark,not offered odds or T-60 information. Same-week control reduces calendar drift but does not identify causality. Division/team/pair dependence persists; block CI cannot eliminate team dependence. One season and prior exposed rows mean development evidence. No ROI/CLV,fees,injury treatment,validation or picks. Across-project family search requires independent future confirmation; passing descriptive rule cannot promote.
next: Implement and test schedule blindness,identity/gates,exclusions,bootstrap before bulk CSV download; retain failures. No new cutoff after inspection.
